name: interview-proof-ai
description: InterviewProof AI — an AI-powered interview-preparation and career-coaching SaaS built on Next.js, featuring an autonomous agentic "Command Center" of company agents (CEO orchestrator, directors, and specialist skills) layered over a candidate-facing report, practice, and scoring pipeline. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
